== Notes ==
* Fevered Dreams will spread the Dazed it applies.
* Dazed will [[cover]] the new condition.
* Since the hex will not trigger when reapplying conditions, consider using [[Hypochondria]] or [[Crystal Wave]] to remove all conditions before reapplying them. [[Reap Impurities]] will remove one condition, likely Dazed. 
* Works well with shouts inflicting conditions, most notably [["You Move Like a Dwarf!"]], [["You Are All Weaklings!"]], and [["Finish Him!"]]. 
{{Bug|Applying or reapplying the hex on a target suffering from one or more condition(s) will trigger the Dazed effect.}}
{{Bug|The Dazed caused by this hex is always spread to foes in the area, even if the target was already Dazed.}}
{{Bug|The Dazed caused by this hex triggers [[Fragility]] twice upon application on the target (but not on surrounding foes).}}
{{Bug|If two foes hexed with Fevered Dreams are next to each other and one of them starts suffering from a new condition, both will be Dazed.}}
